decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Design and Access Statement, Location Plan, HMO Management Plan, 121.18/01, 121.18/02, 121.18/03, and 121.18/04 received: 03/12/2018) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The first floor roof area to the rear of the dwelling hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 4 - The premises shall not be used as a house in multiple occupation, other than a use for not more than six residents within Class C4 of The Town and Country Planning (Use Classes) Order 1987 (as amended) or such other legislation as may subsequently supersede it.

Condition : 5 - Before the use hereby approved commences, full details (including manufacturers' specifications) of secure covered cycle parking facilities shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The approved facilities shall conform to current guidance such as the TfL London Cycling Design Standards in design and layout and be fully implemented and be made available for use before the first occupation of the development and thereafter retained for use at all times without obstruction.
description: Change of use of upper floors into house in multiple occupation use for five persons.
